sections.heading: 1. Introduction
body: As ANKAVERSE (the "Company"), we place great importance on our users' privacy and the protection of their personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we use the information collected when you visit our website.

sections.heading: 2. Information Collected

In addition, you may provide us with personal information such as your name, email address, and phone number through contact forms or newsletter subscriptions.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance

sections.heading: 2. Use of the Service

sections.heading: 3. Disclaimer
body: ANKAVERSE takes the utmost care to ensure that the information on its website is accurate and up-to-date, but makes no guarantees. The content on the site is provided for informational purposes only.

sections.heading: 4. Changes
body: ANKAVERSE reserves the right to update these Terms of Use at any time. Changes take effect on the date they are published.

consent.title: Cookie preference
consent.body: We use cookies to understand how you use our site and to measure ads. These are not required for the site to function; if you reject them, no measurement will be made.
